assets.prompt: Detailed premium pixel art environmental background for a cozy woodland fantasy RPG, 16-bit hand-placed crisp pixel clusters, lush emerald and olive greens, deep teal shadows, warm ochre highlights, moss, ferns, tiny white flowers and mushrooms at the outer edges. Landscape full-bleed composition, side-on slightly elevated camera, layered forest depth. Background scenery only: uninhabited environment, all surfaces clear of writing, empty clear ground reserved for live game sprites. An open circular meeting clearing in the forest at golden-hour sunset, the sky behind the treeline burning amber and rose. In the middle of the clearing, centred horizontally and placed a little below the vertical middle of the image, a crackling campfire of stacked logs with tall orange flames and glowing embers ringed by rounded stones. Around the fire, several thick sawn log stumps serve as rustic benches, drawn small and low so they do not rise above the fire. Strings of small hanging lanterns glow warm amber from the branches at the top of the frame. Dense forest and tall mossy trunks close the left and right borders. THE ENTIRE BOTTOM HALF of the image is flat trodden earth and short grass, one continuous level surface spanning edge to edge, kept plain and clear of clutter to the left and to the right of the fire so several live sprites can stand in a row. Warm inviting evening light. Pure scenery, no people, no animals, no characters, no interface, no text, no frames.

No resampling. Verified byte-identical to the cropped source PNG after decode. Same class of crop as battle.webp, which lost 6 px left and 7 px right.
